Is Seige any good? Torn between picking up it or the Division.

That depends on whether you enjoy team-vs-team games, but I would put it higher on my list than the Division. The Division is great story co-op, but doesn't have much replay value. Siege is fantastic team vs team tactical gameplay, but doesn't have a story; I feel like it doesn't need one, because its replay value is in the multiplayer.

It's team-vs-team that feels like co-op because you have to work so closely with your team. Each operator has a unique ability that mitigates or counters the abilities of other operators, which leads to an interesting dynamic between players. You can also breach through most of the walls and ceiling, using breaching charges to open sight lines, create sudden flanking positions, or act as a distraction as you attack from another angle. It feels a bit like Payday 2 if Payday 2 were team vs team.

All-in-all, Siege is a well-polished team-based shooter that's actually shaping up to be my most played game of 2016.
